title: The Echo (Long Branch, N.J.) 1904-1943
notes: Began in 1904; ceased in 1943. Cf. Wright, W.C. and Stellhorn, P.A. Direct. of N.J. newspapers.
"The oldest colored paper in New Jersey."
"Published weekly in interest of Negro race."
source: Library of Congress, Directory of U.S. Newspapers in American Libraries
